pages.title: What Is DeepSpace?
pages.text: DeepSpace aims to create an infinitely generated universe worth exploring. With the capabilities of Infinite Dimensions, every save can generate an unlimited number of galaxies, each unique and entirely random.

pages.title: Entering Space
pages.text: Reach Y=550 on any planet, including the Overworld, to enter space. If you are riding a Sable sub-level, it will enter space with you.
